notes.title: BIG UPDATE: Dead Eye ability, breast animation, new enemies
notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone,[/b]

We are happy to finally introduce you to our new and most pleasing update.

[h3]The main feature we've added is Dead Eye ability.[/h3] Now you can activate [b]slowmotion [/b]to kill your enemies even more ruthless!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/73ctq3c.gif[/img]

To activate Dead Eye you need to fill with your enemies’ blood grey skulls in the left bottom of the screen. [b]One kill — one skull filled[/b]. After that you can hit "F" button to activate the ability.



[h3]Besides, we've added a couple of new enemy models.[/h3] Plus, now they feature a Voice Acting.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/LmaBALL.gif[/img]



[h3]On top of that, we've added animation to face and boobs.[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hvnZdhL.gif[/img]



[h3]We've worked a bit on our weapons and decided to change grenade to dynamite.[/h3] It’s more cool and now has a nice explosion sound effect. Plus, new blood effect.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/OBSqal3.gif[/img]



[h3]And in addition to all of that, We've added some helpful pointing tips on loading screen.[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36221742/48639029225154524499e82e770cab66a9324e7c.png[/img]



[h3]Cheers,
Konnichiwa Games[/h3]
